scope: Authored TEE context geometry, topology, frame invariance and camera fit. Not donor segmentation, patient registration, collision validation or browser performance.
checks: Fixed orthonormal source-anchored illustrative frame; source frames unchanged and all dimensions in world millimetres.
Continuous esophagogastric junction, orientable mesh, no non-manifold edges; open upper esophagus and pyloric outlet only.
Two-domed diaphragm with open esophageal hiatus, continuous hole rim and distinguished central tendon.
Finite world-mm coordinates, unit smooth normals and consistent face orientation for all surfaces and contours.
Posterior-LA esophagus, short abdominal segment, left-superior fundus, dependent body and rightward antrum; continuous distance-based routing with orthonormal shaft frames.
1551 interior gastric candidates share fixed route indices and retain radial clearance; fundus remains below diaphragm; ME shaft stays within 40° of reviewed 4C normal over 31–35 model cm.
Static anatomy is byte-identical after 60 steering combinations and after replacing the selected source-plane basis.
Both comparison donors use their own measured dimensions and geometric frame; no transferred source landmarks or anatomical registration claims.
Context camera fit contains all organ bounds across five aspect ratios, with the same main-view projection factor.
